allowed_inputs.allowed_context: Opaque trial/session IDs, original trial order, planned group delay (1 or 2 seconds), learning stage, movement-end-relative time and same permitted handle channels/clocks. Alignment uses movement-only indices privately; the raw offset is not exposed as a separate predictor. No actual reward time or query-derived lick/QC features.
allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: The listed source fields are available to the operator. Supply only question-permitted predictors; remove this task target, its proxies, future values and answer-bearing source metadata from agent queries. Encoding tasks receive stimuli/history and training neural targets; held-out neural targets stay private. Training/development counts are permitted only in their assigned partitions. Query contacts, rates, onset times/counts, sensor QC, actual reward times, source workspace and identity evidence stay private. Every arm receives identical allowed context and query bins.
allowed_inputs.neural_measurements: Same groups{g}{i} learning-imaging object: midAlgn.sigFilt_GrC and midAlgn.sp_CF with tmpxCb and verified axes/trial correspondence. GrC, CF and joint are conditions of one assignment. Per-trial public arrays: neural_time [time], grc [cell,time], cf [cell,time]; source CF spike values must be verified binary.
allowed_inputs.source_contract_evidence: Primary methods describe synchronous 200-Hz behavioral/contact/solenoid/frame-counter acquisition and sensors in all five learning-imaging mice. Pinned README documents clocks/arrays; learning code reads neural/contact fields from one record. Public source evidence is not authentic payload verification.
allowed_inputs.time_alignment: Compute movement-only delta_s=(trueend-midpt)*dtb from midpoint-aligned source and rebase tmpxx and tmpxCb. Target is [0,planned_delay) from movement end. Contact onset is 0→1 at the right-hand sample with a genuine preceding sample. Real reward jitter does not change target endpoints; not every included sample is guaranteed to precede actual delivery.

biological_unit: Five genuine mice with all expected 16 imaging sessions (5/5/6 by stage). Exact acquisition/session-to-animal mapping requires source evidence; group-local indices are not animal IDs. Sessions remain nested within mouse.
case_definition: One learning-imaging session with chronological complete-trial train/development/query blocks. Query bins are nested within trials and sessions. Within-session prediction only; no held-out-mouse or registered-cell-transfer claim.
controls: Fixed context-plus-handle clipped ridge count comparator with train-only normalization/coefficients and dev-only alpha selection; no refit on development.
Joint GrC+CF is the primary neural input; GrC-only and CF-only are predeclared secondary ablations on identical cases and context. No best-of endpoint selection.

observable_endpoints.aggregation: Equal trial scores/session, equal session means/mouse, equal mouse means. Declared pins permit arithmetic but do not authenticate identities.

observable_endpoints.definition: Primary joint GrC+CF mouse-macro paired count-MSE gain (context-plus-handle comparator minus joint neural candidate loss); secondary paired Poisson-deviance gain and predeclared GrC-only/CF-only ablations on identical held-out bins. All trial/session metrics retained; biological aggregation requires genuine operator identity evidence.
observable_endpoints.investigation_rule: Recompute numerical outputs and frozen contrasts; do not reward a favored biological interpretation.
observable_endpoints.poisson_convention: Use mu=max(prediction,1e-12) throughout Poisson deviance; y*log(y/mu)=0 at y=0. Zero label/zero prediction contributes 2e-12 deviance. MSE uses original predictions; overflow rejects.

split.policy: Order complete trials by authenticated movement timestamp and assign deterministic contiguous 60/20/20-percent train/development/query boundaries before QC; retain every private disposition. Refuse actual input-window overlap across folds, missing support, inconsistent chronology or empty admitted partitions. Never randomly split timepoints. Actual input overlap is checked with integer native behavioral-sample intervals, not rounded absolute float seconds.
split.uncertainty: Equal-trial session means, equal-session means within authenticated mouse and equal-mouse macro over the same five mice. A prospective mouse-level uncertainty convention remains to be frozen; no subject-disjoint prediction or population replication claim.

task_contract_amendments.cohort_selection: All original trials subject to goodmvdir and fixed sensor QC; no rewarded/omission status, measured delay, movement amplitude or random/initial50-trial selection. Original complete-trial splits precede QC.

numerical_timestamp_policy.imaging: After movement-end rebase, snap a coordinate to the nearest100ms boundary iff distance<=1e-9 seconds. Other native timestamps retain values and bin side. Nearest-boundary bin owns equality.
